channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Norfolk theatre revamp funded by heirs of European tobacco giant
item.description: The first private investment for an ambitious £30m revamp of the Guildhall theatre in King's Lynn was funded by a charity managed by the heirs of Reemtsma cigarettes.

item.title: More details revealed about new 24/7 petrol station
item.description: A noise management plan for the new 24hr petrol station at the former Carscene site in Norwich has been outlined by the applicant, Tankerford Limited.

item.title: Police searching for two men after the death of 23-year-old
item.description: Police say they want to speak with two men in connection to a drug-related incident in which a 23-year-old man died on Bullard Road in NR3.

item.title: Green Party ridiculed as councillors miss key vote by leaving meeting during a break
item.description: A key meeting to vote on demolishing the former Debenhams store in Norwich for student flats turned into a farce after a move to block the scheme was lost due to councillors leaving the meeting.

item.title: Family-run town cafe is set to open on Sundays
item.description: Twyfords Café on Exchange Square, in Beccles, has announced it is due to extend its opening hours and open its doors every day of the week.

item.title: Seaside town bids to become first ever UK Town of Culture
item.description: Britain's most easterly town and the first place in the UK to see the sunrise is bidding for a unique honour - and it is calling for your support!

item.title: Police called out after dangerous pothole damages up to 30 cars
item.description: Suffolk Police attended the incident after receiving several calls about the number of drivers stopping due to damaged cars.

item.title: Grateful for the immeasurable support I have had from the WI
item.description: During the month of February, members all over the country have been asked to share their stories of how we or our WIs have benefited from others’ giving.

item.title: 7 things to do in Great Yarmouth this February half-term
item.description: Families are being promised fun for all ages as Great Yarmouth prepares for a busy February half-term.

item.title: Man pulls unconscious driver from crash wreckage after car tyre 'flew off'
item.description: A good Samaritan has described rushing to the aid of crash victims following a serious collision.
